tasks.corrected_reference_answer: generate_student_impls starts one Process per input, joins every process, then drains a Queue into a dictionary and reconstructs input order (pybryt/student.py:278-306). tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Notebook execution uses ExecutePreprocessor(allow_errors=True), then reads the generated footprint file and removes it (pybryt/execution/__init__.py:81-97). Thus ordinary cell error outputs can coexist with a partial footprint, but timeout/kernel/preprocessing or missing-file failures are not universally recovered here. The check context manager always turns tracing off on exit and creates a report only without an exception or with report_on_error enabled (pybryt/student.py:423-439).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Value.check_values_equal honors a custom equivalence function, then checks iterable/shape compatibility and uses scalar/array tolerance bounds or numpy.allclose for numeric iterables (pybryt/annotations/value.py:224-288). Other values use equality; iterable results are reduced, with paired pandas missing values treated equal (290-304). The set branch sorts/pairs values but constructs np.array from a generator (283-286), so its correctness should be reviewed rather than asserting it reliably checks every paired tolerance.
